contracts: (RMAP-S2 succeeds only when all three named seed occurrences are unique and match the frozen approved non-baseline classifications; the isolated unapproved-or-baseline classification selector fails.) AND (Validation accepts only a three-occurrence evaluation-seed manifest in which each named occurrence records missing_labels.)
selector_intents: Run the RMAP-S2 seed-validation selector with one named occurrence assigned an unapproved or baseline classification; validation must reject that manifest.
Run the evaluation-seed validation selector after removing missing_labels from one named occurrence and require a deterministic validation failure.
